primary_sources.finding: Stripe says it has agreed to acquire OpenRouter; describes routing across 400+ models and 80+ providers. This statement gives no price, consideration mix or close confirmation.

OpenRouter says deal is subject to customary closing conditions and expected to close in coming weeks; product, name, roadmap, integrations and commitments to remain unchanged. Announces >10T tokens/day, >10M developers and >=10x annual inference-volume growth.

startup_fortune.status: Agreement/signing established. Closing status unknown from checked sources; missing close notice is not proof either way. Deal value and consideration remain undisclosed in these primary announcements.
